'''Estefania Sebastian''' (born 5 September 1982) is an Andorran [[Sprint (running)|sprinter]].<ref name="Bio">{{cite web |url=http://www.iaaf.org/athletes/andorra/estefania-sebastian-289264 |title=Estefania Sebastian |accessdate=10 March 2014 |work=IAAF}}</ref> She competed in the [[2014 IAAF World Indoor Championships – Women's 60 metres|60 metres event]] at the [[2014 IAAF World Indoor Championships]].
